UP DGMHUP ANM Training Selected Candidate List / Merit List 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Department of Medical Health & Family Welfare has released the selected candidate list / merit list for the UP DGMHUP ANM Training Entrance Test 2026 examination. Applications for the UP DGMHUP ANM Training Online Form 2026 were accepted from 01 July 2026, to 31 July 2026. Candidates who appeared for this re-examination can download their UP DGMHUP ANM Training Selected Candidate List / Merit List 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 01 July 2026
  • Last Date : 31 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 31 July 2026
  • Merit List : 18 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General : Rs. 200/-
  • OBC, SC, ST : Rs. 100/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking or Pay Offline Through Challan Payment Mode Only.
